mapper.select: SELECT c.*, t.real_name AS teacher_name FROM class c LEFT JOIN teacher t ON c.teacher_id = t.id WHERE c.id = #{id}
SELECT c.*, t.real_name AS teacher_name FROM class c LEFT JOIN teacher t ON c.teacher_id = t.id WHERE c.invite_code = #{inviteCode}

SELECT c.*, t.real_name AS teacher_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_class sc WHERE sc.class_id = c.id AND sc.status = 1) AS student_count FROM class c LEFT JOIN teacher t ON c.teacher_id = t.id WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC

SELECT c.*, t.real_name AS teacher_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_class sc WHERE sc.class_id = c.id AND sc.status = 1) AS student_count FROM class c LEFT JOIN teacher t ON c.teacher_id = t.id WHERE c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC

SELECT c.*, t.real_name AS teacher_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_class sc2 WHERE sc2.class_id = c.id AND sc2.status = 1) AS student_count FROM class c INNER JOIN student_class sc ON c.id = sc.class_id LEFT JOIN teacher t ON c.teacher_id = t.id WHERE sc.student_id = #{studentId} AND sc.status = 1 AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY sc.join_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_class WHERE class_id = #{classId} AND status = 1
SELECT id, name, code, teacher_id, course_id FROM class WHERE name = #{name}
